scenes.say: NASCAR's playoff is almost all ovals. But in twenty twenty seven it gets a road course again.
The Chase is the last ten races of the season. Sixteen drivers qualify on points and nobody gets eliminated.
Richmond opens the Chase. Watkins Glen is the second race, on September nineteenth, and the finale is back at Homestead.
This year's Chase had no road courses. Charlotte went back from the Roval to the oval in October.
On the twenty twenty seven schedule, the playoff includes Watkins Glen, a road course race. Charlotte's layout hasn't been named yet.
The Glen was last in the playoff in twenty twenty four. Now it's coming back.
NASCAR calendar and standings are on LapRadar.

title: Watkins Glen returns to the Chase: a road course in NASCAR's 2027 playoff
